description.value:
Check Intimidation vs. target's Will DC

Effect +1 circumstance bonus (Novice) in a doorway, stairwell, or anywhere retreat isn't obviously available

Stand close enough, still enough, and wrong enough that a target becomes off-guard from proximity alone.

cinderfall.incomplete: Downgraded from REAL to INCOMPLETE during the citation-strength spot-check (2026-09-13): the proposed RollOption(toggleable)+FlatModifier self-bonus (toggle option 'loom-chokepoint') cited only this class's own internal precedent (corporate-cover.json / quick-fingers.json / underledger-rank.json, all in this same folder) -- no real pf2e-source file:line backs this specific mechanism. Checked pf2e-source for a closer match: packs/pf2e/feats/skill/level-1/risky-surgery.json does ship a toggleable RollOption + predicated FlatModifier for a self-elected bonus, but always gated on a concrete, checkable action predicate (action:treat-wounds) plus a stated mechanical cost (1d8 self-damage) -- never on pure narrative/GM judgment with no checkable predicate, which is the shape this proposal used. Left unbuilt pending a stricter design call.
